response.justification: Bogdan shows strong polyglot skills and experience with large-scale systems, but his resume lacks direct evidence of expertise in JVM tooling, enterprise frameworks (e.g., Spring), or IDE internals, which are core to the role. His recent work leans heavily toward web/mobile development and AI-agent tooling, with limited exposure to Java/Kotlin ecosystem specifics required for this position.
strengths: Strong polyglot programming experience across multiple languages and frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, D, Java, etc.)
Proven ability to work on large-scale systems and performance-sensitive applications (e.g., real-time meta data at Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated leadership and mentorship through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions
concerns: No clear evidence of deep expertise in Java/Kotlin or enterprise JVM frameworks (Spring, Quarkus, etc.)
Limited experience with IDE internals or language tooling, which is a key requirement for this role
Most recent roles focus on web/mobile development and AI tooling, not enterprise JVM tooling or developer tools
